test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose ‘No improvement’ as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.**

The cat sits in the window and __staring at__ the squirrel.
solution:
The correct answer is: '**stares at**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct verb tense to use with 'cat' and 'squirrel' i
